description.short: Search your documents, matters, folders, and recent activity.
description.full: search and retrieve content from iManage Work, including documents, matters, folders, libraries, users, workspace templates, document versions, and recent user actions. It can also save new documents and folders to a matter. Available in Microsoft 365 Copilot. An iManage LLC account is required. To sign up, visit https://imanage.com/imanage-products/document-email-management.
